test_cases.name: ai_generated_prop_cleanup
test_cases.input: This Meshy GLB looks messy. Clean it up and make it game-ready for Unity.
assertions: Inspects poly count and reports before/after
Suggests QuadriFlow or Instant Meshes for static prop
Exports FBX or GLB with meters scale

test_cases.name: character_retopo_advice
test_cases.input: I have a high-poly character sculpt. How do I make it animation-ready for Unreal?
assertions: Recommends quad-dominant topology with edge flow
Prefers assisted retopo over pure automatic for deformable
Mentions UV seams aligned with hard edges
Notes Unreal FBX import scale considerations

test_cases.name: print_watertight_check
test_cases.input: Check if this STL is printable and fix the holes.
assertions: Does not force UV or game poly budget

test_cases.name: budget_and_export
test_cases.input: Optimize this prop to under 10k tris for mobile Godot.
assertions: Applies decimation or remesh toward budget
Suggests texture size appropriate for mobile
